title: Love this mug!
text: Love this mug!. Such a cute winter mug - a little Christmasy but not TOO much to use from November into February or March, depending on the kind of winter you enjoy where you live!  And seeing Snoopy and Woodstock all decked out in their winter clothes is so fun!

product_metadata.title: Vandor Peanuts Ugly Sweater 20 Ounce Ceramic Mug, Multicolored
description: Make a statement with your morning cup of joe. The Vandor Peanuts Ugly Sweater 20 Ounce Ceramic Mug is made from high quality stoneware and features a bold and bright character design. Both microwave and dishwasher safe, it ships in a full color gift box and makes the ideal gift for any occasion. Making retro cool since 1957, legends live on at Vandor - suppliers of hip and functional products for fans of all ages.
